core_obligations: Form the fibre product along the diagonal to obtain the closed subspace Z of X (proof lines 3597-3599).
Note that agreement on U gives U contained in Z (proof lines 3599-3600).
Use scheme theoretic density of U in X to conclude Z = X and hence f = g (proof lines 3600-3601).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for morphisms f, g : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over a base B with Y -> B separated, if f and g agree on an open subspace U of X whose scheme theoretic closure is X, then f = g (source lines 3588-3595). The proof forms the fibre product of X along the pair (f, g) and the diagonal of Y, which is a closed subspace Z of X because Y is separated over B; agreement on U puts U inside Z, and scheme theoretic density of U forces Z = X, i.e. f = g.
